main_text.head: Typographus Lectori. S.
main_text.p: [D]Um opusculum hoc D.Roberti Rolloci de efficaci vocatione typis committerem, venit forte in manus D. Theodori Bezæ epistola, ad Scotiam D.Iohanni Iohnstono missa, quæ operum quorūdam ab eodem hoc authore editorum, et a me excusorum, commentarii, inquā, in Epistolā ad Ephesios, & Analyseōs Epistolæ ad Romanos, commendationem continebat. Eam itaque huic operi præmittēdam censui, vt tu (benigne Lector) quodnā viri illius in universa doctrina Theologica exercitatissimi, & de Ecclesia optimè meriti, de hujus Authoris scriptis judicium fit, perspiceres; & ex eo de cæteris ejus laboribus, vel hactenus exaratis, vel impostèrum ad Ecclesiæ vsum exantlandis, æstimares: Deum (cum D. Beza) precatus, vt hunc hominem novis subinde donis auctum fœliciter conservet, & alios, quando ipsi visum fuerit, huic similes operarios in vineam suam emittat. Vale.

page.notes: The initial "D" is a large woodcut letter; reconstructed as [D]. Words such as "Vm" at the start of the paragraph are the rest of "Cum" under the initial, transcribed as printed in the scan ("Vm"). Printed spellings such as "Bezæ", "huic" and "ejus" are kept as printed.
